name: OpenDIMS Integration
brief: Exposes BC data OpenDIMS needs that the standard API does not cover.
description: Publishes read-only API endpoints for OpenDIMS: salesShipments and salesInvoiceLinks (shipment tracking), customerDiscountGroups, itemDiscountGroups and priceListLines (discount matrix sync), and bomComponents (assembly BOM / composed products). Ships granular permission sets (OPENDIMS TRACKING / DISCOUNTS / BOM) so each integration is granted only the data it uses.
